rows.en: Take a good look around... These are Yummy eggs.
Yummy eggs...!? Ankh, what are you trying to say?
So this creepy gunk is Yummy eggs! And? What's your point?
If we leave them like this, Yummies will just keep on hatching, with no end to it.
Looks like this is about as deep as it goes...
Hurry up and grow big and strong now...
Who dares get in the way of my desire!?
Oh my... Ankh? This is no place for little boys like you, you know?
Lovely place, isn't it? Kazari found it for me, you know.
I was here, taking my time and enjoying watching my Yummies hatch...
...And then you lot barged in and got in my way.
I'll never forgive you for this!! Get out of here!!!
As Mezool fell, several Core Medals scattered from her body.
Mezool! I'm taking those Core Medals!
Whoa there! Not so fast, okay?
Kazari!! Move!! Those Core Medals are mine!
Outta my way!! Those Core Medals are mine!
A little too late, weren't you? I already helped myself to all of Mezool's Core Medals.
Well, you really helped me out there. You saved me the trouble of beating her.
You betrayed Mezool... your own comrade?
Comrade...? Sure, we're both Greeed, but that doesn't make us comrades, you know?
I felt like trying a little experiment of my own, see. And for that, I need Mezool's Core Medals.
But she's a Greeed too. I couldn't just take them from her that easily...
So, to save time, I figured I'd have you guys take her down for me.
And for that, I needed Mezool and you lot to end up as enemies.
There's someone in this world who's interested in medal technology, you see.
When I offered them Mezool and her Yummies, they even set up a place like this for me.
That's right. For Mezool, this is the perfect place to raise Yummies.
And Mezool, none the wiser, fell for it hook, line and sinker...
Her desire is maternal love, after all... Fufufu! ...She must've really wanted to raise those eggs!
K-Kazari, you... you sold me out... Next time we meet... y-you'll pay for this...
N-next time we meet... y-you'll pay for this...
Hmm... Where do you think you're going? In that state, I doubt you'll ever revive again, you know?
In that state, I doubt you'll ever revive again.
Hahahahaha!! Well then, I'm a busy guy myself, so...
Well then, I'm a busy guy myself, so...

notes.note: 0238 #0.1-0.8: identical line for each possible party partner; kept identical. 'Chosuijou' = the reservoir Deathscythe Hell mentioned in story_031 (0233 #0.3).

0239 #0.2-0.10 and #0.13-0.21: no speaker except #0.2/#0.13 (00); party-partner variants reacting to Ankh. Voiced by register only: #0.5/#0.16 polite (likely Mebius or OOO; '-san' on Ankh dropped), #0.18 rough (Momotaros/Zero style), #0.9-0.10 silent '...?' (terse pilots). Variant order not verified.
'...tte koto wa, Ankh!!' read as the speaker realising what the eggs imply (a Greeed nearby) and turning to Ankh; kept as an unfinished realisation. #0.17 is the same without the name.
Ankh: subject 'we' restored for 'if (we) leave them'; 'umaretsuzukeru' rendered 'keep on hatching'.
Mis-decoded kanji (the same stand-in for 'ai' seen in earlier slices): 'kawaii' -> 'precious'. Speaker '???' is Mezool (named at #0.7).
#0.6-0.7 are one sentence cut across two rows ('Who!? / ...is it that gets in the way of my desire!!'); #0.7 rendered as its own question so the cut reads naturally.
Mezool's 'bouya-tachi' (motherly, condescending to Ankh and the party) -> 'little boys like you'.
No speaker: rougher alternate of Ankh's #0.20 ('ore n da'); likely Ankh in another branch.
No speaker; a party member (probably the leader, 00) challenging Kazari. #0.26 has no speaker but is clearly Kazari's reply.
Kazari's unnamed backer ('someone in this world interested in medal tech'): gender unknown -> 'they'.
Mis-decoded kanji again: 'bosei-ai' = maternal love (Mezool's desire in OOO canon).
'Oboete-rasshai' (feminine 'you'll remember this') -> 'you'll pay for this', stammer kept.
'Boku mo hima ja nai n de ne' is an exit line; kept trailing. #0.38/#0.40/#0.42 are shorter alternates of #0.37/#0.39/#0.41.
Item-get message follows story_010 format ('Obtained the "Rider Pass".'); glossary spelling 'Gundanium alloy' kept, no article for a material.
0241 #0.3-0.7: no speaker; party-partner variants of the item-get reaction (#0.4 is 00 by self-naming; #0.5 terse, Wing Zero style). Continues into story_033.

report: 80/80 rows. Mis-decoded kanji in 0240 #0.2 (kawaii) and #0.35 (bosei-ai) inferred from context. Speakers inferred: 0240 #0.2-0.6 Mezool, #0.21 Ankh alt, #0.25 party member (likely 00), #0.26 Kazari. Party-variant rows in 0238/0239/0241 voiced by register only; variant order unverified. Kazari's backer kept gender-neutral. Not in glossary: 'reservoir' (facility).
